The ledger does not support that claim.

Spend from 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-14 was $927.37.  
Spend from 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-23 was $1,110.94.

The difference is $183.57, an increase of about 19.8%, not a tripling. No model, tool-version, or plan-setting changes were recorded in the days before 2026-09-15, so the ledger shows no cause for a larger shift.
